claims.reason: The inequality holds for every integer k (see the hk entry), so hN is not needed. Without hk, (k:ℝ) ≤ k.toNat (Int.self_le_toNat, Init/Data/Int/Order.lean:697) replaces hkcast, and linarith with hτ.2 and hj (cast) proves both goals. You can also keep hk: since N ≥ 0, mem_paperBohrIndices gives 3N/5 ≤ k, so 0 ≤ k. With hN deleted, the statement still elaborates because N remains bound and is used in hk.

Let m = k.toNat. Int.self_le_toNat gives k ≤ m, hj gives m+1 ≤ j and hτ gives τ < 1/2. So k+τ−j ≤ τ−1 < 0, and |k+τ−j| = j−k−τ ≥ j−m−τ > j−m−1/2. By Nat.cast_sub hj, j−m−1/2 is exactly the left-hand side. hk is mentioned nowhere else in the statement, so deleting it leaves the statement well-formed, and linarith closes the goals once (k:ℝ) ≤ m replaces hkcast.
